faculty_group: For Full-Time Faculty Members
For a full-time faculty member who is or will be the parent responsible for the majority of the child care, University policy supplements this federal requirement as follows:
eligible_parent: when the faculty member gives birth, adopts a child, or has a spouse or University-registered domestic or civil union partner who gives birth
entitlement: the University allows, without regard to the start date of employment, the faculty member to have a one-quarter paid leave
Where both parents are members of the faculty, each may have a quarter’s leave.
duration: the University allows, without regard to the start date of employment, the faculty member to have a one-quarter paid leave
caregiver_condition: For a full-time faculty member who is or will be the parent responsible for the majority of the child care, University policy supplements this federal requirement as follows:
service_requirement: the University allows, without regard to the start date of employment, the faculty member to have a one-quarter paid leave
time_window: All leaves and course reductions must be taken within one year of the arrival of the child.
notice: The faculty member should discuss his or her leave and course reduction plans with the section chief (if applicable), department chair, or dean a minimum of three months before the proposed leave or course reduction.
dual_employee_rule: Where both parents are members of the faculty, each may have a quarter’s leave.
runs_concurrently_with: Parental leave is considered leave under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)

notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. All five usable sources are Wayback copies of 7-15 March 2018; the handbook Leaves section's Stopping the Clock clause was last revised 19 February 2018, before the reference date.

Governing documents: the Office of the Provost faculty handbook (Leaves section 2018_01, which contains the Parental Leave for Faculty clause also saved alone as 2018_00; Appointment and Promotion 2018_02). missing=false.

2018_03 (Academic Leaves of Absence) holds only research-leave guidance: no institution-wide policy; unit policies (Humanities Research Leave Program, Social Sciences Faculty Research Program) not saved. Not usable for a birth.

2018_04 (HR Vacation, Holidays, and Time Off) is a navigation page for staff; it lists staff policies 504-523 (not saved) and refers faculty to their department or the Provost's Office. No terms coded from it.

Calendar: quarters. The handbook grants 'a one-quarter paid leave' and appointments are three- or four-quarter (Statute 14.1: '14.1. Three-Quarter Appointments: Each Faculty member under this type of appointment shall perform service in residence during three Quarters of the member’s appointive year'). No quarter length stated: calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order.
Paid quarter (c1): no pay level is stated beyond 'paid leave'; pay_fraction left empty (derivation counts it at 100% with a note).

Faculty short-term disability (c5, c6) does not exclude pregnancy; the OAA short-term disability plan does ('your illness or disability cannot be work-related or pregnancy-related', footnote referring OAA to their parental leave). The OAA STD (60% of base salary, up to 11 weeks, after 6 months' service) is therefore not a component (a parent cannot use it for a birth); OAA unpaid leave pending LTD likewise not coded.

The handbook's FMLA restatements (child care leave for a faculty foster placement, 'may request a leave without salary of up to twelve weeks'; OAA birth/adoption/foster child care leave; care-giver's leave for a family member's serious health condition) add no length to FMLA and are coded as the statute (c3), per schema statute_source.

Returning from LTD: a faculty member on LTD may resume the position within two years of the first day of short-term disability leave on a medical finding; recorded here only (job return right on LTD, no separate leave).

Cross-references not saved: FMLA Request Form for Faculty and OAA; OAA Short-term Disability Form; Sick Leave and Short-term Disability Leave for OAA (attachment); BSD faculty sick leave policy (School of Medicine faculty); Basic and Optional LTD plan documents (Benefits Office); Vacation (Provost handbook section); HR policies 504 Jury Duty, 505 Voting, 506 Bereavement, 508 Personal Leave of Absence, 509 Vacation, 510 University Holidays, 511 Personal Holidays, 512 Sick Leave, 513 Short-Term Disability, 514 Long-Term Disability, 517 Active Military Service, 518 Military Reserve Training, 521 School Visitation, 522 FMLA, 523 Court Appearances (staff); HR Adoption benefit page (navigation link only); Humanities Research Leave Program; Social Sciences Faculty Research Program; University Statutes section 11.2 (full text); Workers' Compensation SPD; Conflict of Interest policy, OAA Guidelines PDF and other appointment documents (not leave-related).

Chain, birth parent: paid quarter (c1) with FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from its start (c3, S1); course reduction (c2) also available within one year (not converted to weeks); separately, short-term disability leave (c5) with full-salary pay within it (c6) and sick leave alongside (c4), also inside FMLA; if LTD is applied for, pay may continue up to one more quarter (c7, consecutive_after c6); if not, discretionary unpaid leave up to two years from the first day of c5 (c5 within c8).
Chain, non-birth parent: paid quarter (c1) if the majority caregiver, with FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from its start (c3); course reduction (c2) also available within one year.
Tenure clock: automatic one-year extension per birth or adoption with equal or primary caregiving (c11); a separate one-time discretionary extension for other reasons (c12, general purpose).
